additions.title: RDA Singapore — Therapy Session Volunteers

additions.description: Start as a side-walker supporting riders during equine-assisted sessions. Training is provided.

discovery.restrictions: Age 16+. Once weekly on the same session for 10 consecutive weeks; closed-toe shoes and suitable clothing. All start as side-walkers.
discovery.notes: Organiser always welcomes volunteers. Registration introduction and Next control loaded; no form completed. Placement depends on availability.
